description: "Another World: Fragments from the Star City of Montalluyah" by Benjamin Lumley is a science fiction narrative written in the late 19th century.
longDescription: The story unfolds in Montalluyah, a highly civilized and advanced world inhabited by humans similar to those on Earth.
